status: TEST-ONLY prospective independent-lane WSC SIMD contract; original production oscillator and Engine source unchanged; zero optimized backend calls or speedup claims
immutable_independent_reference: tests/reference/WscLoopOriginal.h (separate namespace, frozen original scheduler, physical state, events, antialias residuals and diagnostic history)
why: ReconstructedOscillator::tick accounted for 27.32% of a previously retained held-source Callgrind instruction profile, not 27.32% of native wall time. The existing one-segment no-event scalar shortcut cannot remove most full oscillator cost. Investigate actual four-double-lane AVX2 WSC arithmetic only after this independent byte/state oracle passes.

source_continuation.exactness: Every compared public output and state/diagnostic field must match the immutable original double bit pattern, including signed zero, all three 16-slot antialias residual histories, all 64 diagnostic event records including inactive slots, counters, reset/slice/comparator states, branch-search count and elapsedSeconds. No numerical tolerance, NaN normalization or source re-pinning.
source_continuation.per_lane_ownership: Every lane owns its own frequency, comparator threshold, switch gates, reset plateau, physical capacitors, residual cursor, basis/profile, diagnostics and clocks. Masked lanes never advance. Changing one lane cannot contaminate another; copy, assignment, restore, idle advance and wake remain independently exact.
source_continuation.event_causality: A variable number of branch/root/reset events per lane must follow the scalar event order. No approximation to exp, log1p, long-double root certification, 2e-15 endpoint rule or 2e-11 sided comparator guard. Eventful/exceptional/divergent lanes may take the original scalar fallback; a claimed batch must prove actual vector arithmetic in qualifying event-free subsegments.
source_continuation.Engine_scheduling: Precompute original vi/ch WSC controls and RNG draws in original order; batch only independent WSC ticks; preserve modern prior-rank readouts, HP-before-LP, filter/amp/VCA clocks, old mix order, first-wake and oscillator-to-filter control flow. No dummy padding lane may be ticked, and no delayed rank state read may observe current instead of previous sample.
source_continuation.fp: Cover FE_TONEAREST, FE_DOWNWARD, FE_UPWARD, FE_TOWARDZERO and all available x86 MXCSR FTZ/DAZ combinations. Preserve caller x87 and SSE rounding, sticky flags, invalid/underflow behavior and signed-zero; use scalar fallback for unqualified modes/ISA without changing the caller environment. No fast-math or FMA contraction change.
source_continuation.physical: No oscillator waveform, segment-cache, alias, event time, nominal RC, profile, output unit or physical model edit is authorized by this software scheduling contract.

pre_source_scalar_positive_control.denormal_modes: All locally supported x86 FTZ/DAZ combinations; if not supported, report noncoverage and run portable nearest fallback rather than synthesize hardware support
pre_source_scalar_positive_control.scheduling: 192 samples per width/rate in nearest mode, plus 128 samples for 4-lane all-rate/all-rounding/denormal matrix. Deterministic rotating order, independently masked lanes, threshold/frequency/saw/pulse changes, stopped/invalid controls, copy, reset, state restore, idle/first-wake, exact physical boundaries and diagnostic history checks every sample.
pre_source_scalar_positive_control.minimum: Positive control must run all 8 widths and 4 rates, exercise each eligible lane at least once, both active and masked ticks, nonzero event and no-event counts, full exact output/state/diagnostic checks, and zero mismatches. Existing original WSC 56,576-tick/44,294,052-bit oracle remains mandatory.

negative_controls.CS80_WSC_LANE_MUTATE_MASK: Tick a masked candidate lane but not frozen original; must exit 1 with named lane.state/diagnostics assertion
negative_controls.CS80_WSC_LANE_MUTATE_CROSS_LANE: Drive one candidate lane from a neighbor's frequency; must exit 1 at output/physical-state assertion
negative_controls.CS80_WSC_LANE_MUTATE_EVENT: Alter one candidate-only observed diagnostic event timestamp by one ULP; must exit 1 at events.absoluteSeconds assertion
negative_controls.CS80_WSC_LANE_MUTATE_FP: Clear candidate FE_INEXACT sticky exception at an instrumented tick; must exit 1 at fp.exceptions assertion

future_backend_work_witness: Instrument real Engine WSC batch entries and actual double-precision AVX arithmetic iterations/independent lane commits, scalar event/FP fallbacks, masked/no-event lanes, copies and wake. Source mutants that fake vector work or execute scalar only must fail a named actual-work gate with exit 1; vector load/store alone is not proof of a nonlinear WSC speedup.
admission: After the frozen positives and source mutations, pass unchanged all WSC oscillator/alias/phase/wake/Legacy/V1/V2/click/circuit core gates. Only then coordinate three uncontended before/after full 27-case, 51-row source-factory rounds with identical benchmark source and source manifests. Preserve every checksum, p99, missed deadline, moving/idle/Legacy control and outlier. Hard held 0.15-0.20 RTF and idle <=0.02 remain RED, even if local oscillator performance improves. No PR6/main/merge/tag/release or physical pin change.
